summary: A button: words, an icon and words, or an icon alone named by its label. A button that cannot act says why; a busy one keeps its place and its focus.

anatomy.container: The pressable box: ground, edge (1px, transparent unless the variant draws one) and corners.
anatomy.label: The words, on one line, never wrapped. Absent in an icon button.
anatomy.icon: A glyph before the label (start) or after it (end); the whole content of an icon button.
anatomy.spinner: While busy: in the leading icon's place, or before the label when there is no icon. The label stays.
anatomy.tooltip: An icon button's label, or the reason a button cannot be pressed now, with a shortcut key when given.

variant.does: The look. One default (filled) button per group, the main action, placed last.

size.does: Height, padding, text and icon size. The icon sizes are square.

iconPlace.does: Where the icon stands; the padding on that side is smaller.
iconPlace.context: has-data-[icon=inline-start] / has-data-[icon=inline-end] on the icon element

busy.does: Work a press started is under way: the spinner shows, presses are ignored, focus and look are kept.

reason.does: Why it cannot be pressed now. Disables it, keeps it in the tab order, and says the reason in a tooltip on hover and focus.

disabled.does: Cannot be pressed and leaves the tab order. Prefer `reason`.

destructiveHover.does: Any variant takes the critical tint under the pointer, for a button that destroys but should not shout at rest.

opensMenu.does: The button opens a menu: it does not sink when pressed, and draws the open state while its menu is open.

inGroup.does: Inside a button group: the small sizes take the full control radius and the group squares the inner corners.

label.does: Icon button only: its name and its tooltip, one string so the two never drift.

tooltip.does: Icon button only: a longer sentence the tooltip says in place of the label.

shortcut.does: Icon button only: the key that does the same, drawn as a key in the tooltip.

pressed.does: Icon button only: on or off, for a button that toggles; left out for one that acts.

xs.note: Keeps its drawn size below md, unlike every other size, and takes a finger-square hit area centered on it instead (FINGER_HIT in lib/finger), unless it is placed by its own position (takesFinger).

icon-xs.note: Keeps its drawn size below md and takes a finger-square hit area, as xs does.

icon-sm.note: IconButton's default size. Square at density.control-sm.

phoneBelow.note: The md breakpoint: below it phoneMinHeight and phoneMinWidth apply.

spinner.note: At the icon size of the button's size: 12 for xs and icon-xs, 14 for sm.

controlHeights.note: density control-xs, control-sm, control, control-lg: 24/28/32/36 regular, 20/24/28/32 compact. Button (its icon squares too), Input, the select triggers, the input group and the other controls read them, so controls side by side stand level at either density.

hover.means: The pointer is over an enabled, idle button.

pressed.means: The pointer is down on it.

disabled.sokkel-ui: With reason: focusable, tooltip on hover and focus. With disabled alone: out of the tab order.

invalid.means: Marked invalid by a form, as a control in a refused group.
invalid.sokkel-ui: aria-invalid: the shared issue edge (INVALID_EDGE in lib/issue-edge.ts), critical/80 in both schemes, the edge alone at rest; no prop sets it

invalid+focus.means: An invalid button with keyboard focus: the focus outline and a 3px ring. The ring shows only with focus, never at rest.
invalid+focus.sokkel-ui: aria-invalid:focus-visible: the invalid ring, ring-invalid and ring-invalid-ring (the shared issue edge)

busy.means: A press started work that is under way.
busy.sokkel-ui: aria-busy and aria-disabled; the look of rest kept (opacity-100), no hover

hover.note: The ground is replaced, so what is beneath shows through 20 percent.

rest.note: IconButton: ghost by default, its icon in the quiet ink until hovered.

pressed.note: The toggle's on state (pressed: true), not the pointer's press.

rest.note: An overlay the destructiveHover option lays over any variant: rest is the variant's own, only hover changes.
Over every variant: what is the same whatever the variant.

keyboard.does: Reaches the button, also while busy and while disabled with a reason; not while disabled without one.
Shows the tooltip: an icon button's label, a reason, a shortcut.

appText.label: Required for an icon button: its name and its tooltip. A text button's words are its content.
appText.reason: Why it cannot be pressed now, in the app's words.
appText.tooltip: A longer sentence than the label, for an icon button.
appText.shortcut: The key, as the device writes it (shortcutLabel in sokkel-ui).

sokkel-ui: Base UI's Button; focusableWhenDisabled keeps a reasoned or busy button in the tab order.

The tooltip is the library's (parts/tooltip) around the button; a reason wraps the button in one, and is also the button's description: aria-describedby names a visually hidden copy of the reason, always in the page beside the button, so a screen reader says it with or without the tooltip open. An icon button's reason is described the same way.
The busy spinner is aria-hidden; the button says aria-busy.
The hover expressions stay in its classes (hover:bg-primary/80); its parts test maps each paint expression to the class it expects.
sokkel-ui-egui: Reads paints (button.<variant>.<state>.container) and never mixes colors.
A busy spinner is painted and asks for a repaint each frame; with motion reduced it should stand still.
A busy or reasoned button keeps its focus with Sense::focusable_noninteractive; a disabled tooltip is on_disabled_hover_text.

drift.spec: The resolved paint button.secondary.hover.container (mix(secondary, foreground 5%) in oklch, resolved at build time).
drift.today: lerp_to_gamma, a blend in gamma space.
Drawn on any focus (has_focus); keyboard-only needs the last input kind tracked.

drift.spec: Icon sizes, IconButton (label, pressed, shortcut), destructiveHover, opensMenu and open, inGroup, iconPlace end, invalid, phone heights below md and the xs hit area.
